name.zh: Tsai CITY 创新创业中心
name.en: Tsai Center for Innovation at Yale (Tsai CITY)

summary.zh: 耶鲁创新创业的核心机构：Accelerator、Launch Pad、Intensives 等项目，对全校学生开放。
summary.en: Yale's hub for innovation: Accelerator, Launch Pad, Intensives and more, open to all students.

tips.zh: Accelerator 每学期一期，申请时项目不需要成型，重点讲问题与团队。
tips.en: The Accelerator runs each semester; you don't need a finished product — focus on the problem and the team.

summary.zh: 学校层面的技术转化与创业支持，涵盖专利、创业基金与创业者驻校计划。
summary.en: University-level tech transfer and venture support: patents, venture funds and entrepreneur-in-residence programs.

tips.zh: 基于实验室成果的项目先找 Yale Ventures 谈知识产权归属。
tips.en: If your project comes out of a lab, talk to Yale Ventures about IP ownership first.

summary.zh: 每年春季的校级创业比赛，多个赛道，奖金可作为启动资金。
summary.en: Annual spring pitch competition with several tracks; prize money doubles as seed funding.

tips.zh: 往届获奖项目 deck 在校友群里可以找到。
tips.en: Past winners' decks circulate in the alumni groups — ask.

name.zh: CEID 工程创新与设计中心

summary.zh: 开放的原型制作空间：3D 打印、激光切割、电子工作台，注册会员即可使用。
summary.en: Open prototyping space: 3D printers, laser cutters, electronics benches — register to use.

summary.zh: Entrepreneurial Finance、Startup Founder Studies 等课程对非 SOM 学生也开放旁听 / 选修。
summary.en: Courses such as Entrepreneurial Finance and Startup Founder Studies are open to non-SOM students by petition.

tips.zh: 选课前先给教授写邮件说明背景，通过率高。
tips.en: Email the professor with your background before registering — approval rates are high.

summary.zh: 学生创业社团，定期办 founder talk 与黑客松。
summary.en: Student-run entrepreneurship club with founder talks and hackathons.

summary.zh: 愿意看校友项目的投资人校友名单，登录后在校友目录按「融资」筛选。
summary.en: Alumni investors willing to review Yale projects — filter the directory by 'Funding' after signing in.

tips.zh: 先发一页纸摘要，不要直接发完整 deck。
tips.en: Send a one-pager first, not the full deck.

name.zh: 回国创业：校友孵化资源
name.en: Founding in China: alumni incubation resources

summary.zh: 上海、北京校友整理的回国落地清单：注册公司、人才引进政策、园区补贴。
summary.en: Checklist compiled by Shanghai and Beijing alumni: company registration, talent policies, park subsidies.

tips.zh: 留学人员创业园对海归有租金减免，先查各区政策。
tips.en: Returnee entrepreneurship parks offer rent relief — check district policies first.

summary.zh: East Rock 安静适合家庭；Downtown 离校近；Wooster Square 性价比高。避开夜间偏僻街区。
summary.en: East Rock is quiet and family-friendly; Downtown is closest to campus; Wooster Square is good value. Avoid isolated blocks at night.

tips.zh: 6 月前签下一年的房子最便宜，8 月最贵。
tips.en: Leases signed before June are cheapest; August is peak.

summary.zh: 校友维护的中餐、亚超清单，每学期更新。
summary.en: Alumni-maintained list of Chinese restaurants and Asian groceries, updated each semester.

tips.zh: Hong Kong Market 周末人少。
tips.en: Hong Kong Market is quieter on weekends.

summary.zh: 学生保险覆盖范围、预约方式、急诊与 Urgent Care 的区别。
summary.en: What student insurance covers, how to book, and ER vs. urgent care.

tips.zh: 牙科与眼科多数不在基础计划里，需要单独加。
tips.en: Dental and vision are mostly outside the basic plan — add them separately.

name.zh: 新生美国银行卡与信用记录

summary.zh: 落地后第一周开 checking；无 SSN 也能申请的信用卡有哪些；信用分从零开始的路线。
summary.en: Open a checking account in week one; credit cards you can get without an SSN; a path from zero credit.

tips.zh: 校友推荐先办学生卡，6 个月后再申请主流卡。
tips.en: Start with a student card; apply for mainstream cards after six months.

name.en: Getting between New Haven and NYC

summary.zh: Metro-North 最便宜稳定，Amtrak 快但贵；周末票与月票攻略。
summary.en: Metro-North is cheapest and reliable, Amtrak faster but pricier; weekend and monthly ticket tips.

summary.zh: 毕业前 90 天申请 OPT；STEM 延期；H-1B 抽签在 3 月。每年校友更新一次。
summary.en: Apply for OPT within 90 days before graduation; STEM extension; H-1B lottery in March. Updated yearly by alumni.

tips.zh: 非官方信息，以 OISS 为准。

name.en: Renting in NYC without getting burned

summary.zh: Broker fee、guarantor、40x 房租收入要求的解释；校友合租群入口。
summary.en: Broker fees, guarantors and the 40x-rent rule explained; link to the alumni roommate group.

tips.zh: 新毕业生可以用 offer letter 代替收入证明。
tips.en: New grads can use the offer letter as proof of income.

summary.zh: 住哪儿取决于公司：南湾 vs 旧金山的通勤时间与租金对比。
summary.en: Where to live depends on your office: South Bay vs. SF commute times and rents compared.

summary.zh: 适合 8–12 人聚餐、离地铁近的餐厅清单。
summary.en: Restaurants that seat 8–12 and sit near the metro.

name.zh: 英国 Graduate Visa 与找工作

summary.zh: 毕业生签证 2 年，转 Skilled Worker 的薪资门槛与担保公司列表。
summary.en: Two-year graduate visa; salary threshold for Skilled Worker and where to find the sponsor list.

name.zh: 回国医保与商业保险衔接
name.en: Bridging China public insurance and private cover after returning

summary.zh: 回国入职前的空窗期怎么办、海归医保补缴。
summary.en: Covering the gap before your first job in China and catching up on public insurance.

summary.zh: 第一周需要买什么、去哪儿买（IKEA、Target、Costco 拼车群）。
summary.en: What to buy in week one and where (IKEA, Target, Costco carpool group).

tips.zh: 学联每年 8 月组织 IKEA 拼车。
tips.en: ACSSY organizes IKEA carpools every August.
